t: This is Clareville House, a grade two listed office building on the north side of Panton Street in Westminster, with shops on the ground floor. It also borders Oxenden Street and Whitcomb Street. Albert Richardson designed it in 1955, and it was built between 1961 and 1963 for Stone's Chop House, which closed in 1981. Richardson was a leading architect, teacher and writer, a President of the Royal Academy, and founder of the Georgian Group.
